messages:
Noah: Quick thread  planning a one-off 'Deep Dive' newsletter tied to the benchmark webinar. Goal: convert engaged viewers -> sandbox trials. Need tight segmentation by ARR (<$500k, $500k-$5M, >$5M) and two subject variants per segment. Also local send windows for EMEA and JP.

Ivy: For ARR segs: small biz -> short social proof + CTA; mid-market -> case study + ROI bullets; enterprise -> invite to a 1:1 tech review. Suggest subject tests: 1) benefit-led (short) 2) curiosity-led (question).

Ethan: Deliverability plan: seed test (100) 48hrs, then 2-step ramp (5% -> 60%) across 12 hrs. Use dedicated IP subset for enterprise sends. Add List-Unsubscribe header and custom subdomain tracking.

Mina: Localization ask: JP + DE if segment size >250. Please freeze base copy by Tue EOD to give translators 48h. Also translate subject A only for JP.

Noah: UTM pattern: ?utm_campaign=deepdive_launch_3750001234&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter&utm_content=<seg>_<variant>. KPI targets: Open > 30% (small), CTR >6% (mid), Demo request >=1.2% (enterprise). Stop follow-ups if unsub rate >0.5% or spam complaints spike.

Ivy: Creative: include 2 short GIFs showing perf charts, mobile-first layout, and 2 subject+preheader combos per seg. Schedule: seed Thu 10:00 PT, main send Fri 09:00 PT (EMEA shift +8h, JP shift +12h).

LocalizeBot: Reminder: Localization queue created for 3750001234. ETA: 48h. :globe_with_meridians:

Ethan: I'll drop export queries and seed list into the doc and run the ramp.

Noah: Perfect. I'll consolidate into the launch checklist and loop in ops for IP warmup. Post any blockers here.
